name: i2c_target
description: I2C target, write transactions to address 0x48: the core's coded shifter samples SDA on SCL rises (8 bits, MSB first); the lane detects START and STOP, matches the address, ACKs each byte and streams it to SRAM. in0 is SCL (uio5), in1 is SDA (uio6). SDA is out0 (uio6), open drain as a selection: value low, enabled by action 0. Action 1 holds the shifter in abort; the idle actions set it, so a STOP that leaves the shifter mid-word drops that word when the lane halts.
